Exchanges.Text: Good morning, Payments (Demo) team. Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check first: is story 3 done, is story 4 done, is task 15 done, and is task 19 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: Yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, and today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, with nothing blocking you.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock the summary page while you’re waiting for the idempotency keys?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, are story 2, story 5, and bug 12 done from your earlier commitments?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timing out and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted your blocker and commitment, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, is story 1 done, and is task 14 done?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted you finished refund API tests and are working on the payment retry story, with no blockers.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Who can help unblock this, given the sandbox was down and you expect to finish it tomorrow?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker about the sandbox depending on the platform team and your commitment to sync with her after the stand-up, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: Maya is blocked on bug 12 due to sandbox gateway timeouts and needs access to the platform team’s staging gateway, the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, and the sandbox dependency on the platform team affected timing. A side discussion about gateway timeouts and configuration was parked for offline follow-up. One item wasn’t covered: task 19 is stale, at risk, and a missed commitment, and the owner will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including any for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
